title: [SEC0] SPA fallback: paths with dots treated as files (false 404s)
description:
Location: crates/kithd/src/static_files.rs line 20

The SPA fallback check uses `!path.contains('.')` to detect whether a path should trigger the fallback or return 404. This is incorrect for paths like `/chat/room.1/messages` that contain a dot but are not file extensions.

Correct behavior: The check should distinguish file extensions from dots in path segments. A path should trigger SPA fallback only if it has no file extension (e.g., ends with a path segment that contains no dot). Example: `/chat/room.1/messages` is a route and should fallback to index.html; `/chat/room.txt` is a file request and should 404 if not found.

Current behavior: /chat/room.1/messages returns 404 instead of serving index.html for client-side routing.

Fix: Check if the final path segment (after last /) contains a dot, not the entire path. Or check if the path ends with a known file extension before the 404 fallback logic.
